paite: "Van lalgam tuh inn neipa grephuan a sem dingte chial ding a zing a pawtkhia bang ahi.
heading: Grephuan Nasemte Gentehna
english: “For the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who was the master of a household, who went out early in the morning to hire laborers for his vineyard.

paite: Ama'n nasemte toh ni khat a makhai loh dia akituahtak un agrephuan ah asawl chiat hi.
english: When he had agreed with the laborers for a denarius a day, he sent them into his vineyard.

paite: Huan dak thumna ding vel in ava pawt a, midang dawr mun a dingh maimaite amu hi.
english: He went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace.

paite: Akiang uah, 'nou leng grephuan ah va pai sam ve ua, akilawm hun ka hon pe na ding,' achi hi.
english: He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and whatever is right I will give you.’ So they went their way.

paite: Huchi in apaita uhi. Huan dak gukna ding leh dak kuana ding vel in ava pawt nawn a, huchi mah bang in ahih nawn hi.
english: Again he went out about the sixth and the ninth hour, and did likewise.

paite: Huan dak sawm-le-khatna ding in ava pawt a, midang dinghte amu a; akiang uah, 'Bangziak a nitum a hiai lai a dingh maimai na hi ua?' achi hi.
english: About the eleventh hour he went out and found others standing idle. He said to them, ‘Why do you stand here all day idle?’

paite: Amau akiang ah, 'kuamah in ahon chial louh ziak un,' achi uhi. Ama'n akiang uah, 'Nou leng grephuan ah va hoh sam un,' achi hi.
english: “They said to him, ‘Because no one has hired us.’ “He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and you will receive whatever is right.’

paite: "Huan nitaklam ahong hih in, grephuan neipa'n asumkempa kiang ah, 'Nasemte samkhawm inla, ananungpen a kipan amasapen tan in aloh uh pia in,' achi hi.
english: “When evening had come, the lord of the vineyard said to his manager, ‘Call the laborers and pay them their wages, beginning from the last to the first.’

paite: Huan dak sawm-le-khatna ding khawng a achialte ahong uleh makhai amu chiat uhi.
english: “When those who were hired at about the eleventh hour came, they each received a denarius.

paite: Amasapente ahong ua, muh tam deuh akigingta ua; himahleh amau leng makhai mah amu chiat uhi.
english: When the first came, they supposed that they would receive more; and they likewise each received a denarius.

paite: Aloh uh asantak un, inn neipa tung ah aphun uhi.
english: When they received it, they murmured against the master of the household,

paite: Hiai nanungpente'n dakkal khat kia asem ua, kou sun haksa leh kho-ul thuakte toh kibang in na bawl a," chi in.
english: saying, ‘These last have spent one hour, and you have made them equal to us who have borne the burden of the day and the scorching heat!’

paite: Ama'n bel alak ua mi khat kiang ah, "Lawm, na tung ah bangmah ka hihkhial sam a; makhai loh ding a kithukim i hi kei maw?
english: “But he answered one of them, ‘Friend, I am doing you no wrong. Didn’t you agree with me for a denarius?

paite: Nang a la inla pai mai in; nang ka hon piak bangmah hiai nanungpen kiang ah ka pe nuam ahi.
english: Take that which is yours, and go your way. It is my desire to give to this last just as much as to you.

paite: Kei a hiven, ka ut-ut a ka hih asiang kei a hia? Ahihkeileh kei ka hoih ziak in nang na haza a hia?" chi in adawng hi.
english: Isn’t it lawful for me to do what I want to with what I own? Or is your eye evil, because I am good?’

paite: "Huchi in ananungpente, amasapente ahong hi ding ua, amasapente leng ananungpente ahong hi ding uh," achi hi.
english: So the last will be first, and the first last. For many are called, but few are chosen.”

paite: Jerusalem a ahohtouh lai in Jesu'n anungzui sawm-le-nihte apituam a, lampi ah akiang uah,
heading: Jesu'n Asihna Ding Genkholhna Thumveina / (Mar 10.32-34; Luk 18.5-43)
english: As Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples aside, and on the way he said to them,

paite: "Ngai dih uh, Jerusalem ah i paitou dia, siampu liante leh laigelhmite khut a Mihing Tapa matsak in a-om ding a; amau si ding in atung ah thu ahihpuk ding uhi.
english: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and scribes, and they will condemn him to death,

paite: Nuihza bawlna dia zat ding leh kilhden ding in Zentelte kiang ah ape ding uh; huan, ani thum ni in kaihthoh in a-om ding," achi hi.
english: and will hand him over to the Gentiles to mock, to scourge, and to crucify; and the third day he will be raised up.”

paite: Huai laitak in, Zebedai tapate nu, atate pi in akiang ah ahong a, amah bia in thil banghiam angen hi.
heading: Zebedai Tapate Dia Ngetsakna / (Mar 10.35-45)
english: Then the mother of the sons of Zebedee came to him with her sons, kneeling and asking a certain thing of him.

paite: Huan ama'n akiang ah, "Bang ahia na deih?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Hiai ka tapa nihte na gam ah na taklam ah khat, na veilam ah khat atuttheihna ding un thu pia in," achi hi.
english: He said to her, “What do you want?” She said to him, “Command that these, my two sons, may sit, one on your right hand and one on your left hand, in your Kingdom.”

paite: Jesu'n, "Na nget uh thei lou hi uteh. Ka nou dawn ding na dawn thei ua hia? Ka baptisma tan ding na tang thei ding ua hia?" chi in adawng hi. Amau akiang ah, "Thei e,” achi uhi.
english: But Jesus answered, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I am about to drink, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?” They said to him, “We are able.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Ka nou na dawn ngei ding ua; ka baptisma tan ding na tang thei ding uh. Himahleh ka taklam leh ka veilam a tut ding thu zaw kei piak ding ahi kei, ka Pa bawlsakte a ding ahi zaw ding," achi hi.
english: He said to them, “You will indeed drink my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with; but to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give, but it is for whom it has been prepared by my Father.”

paite: Huchi in sawmkhatte'n huai azak un unau nihte tung ah ahehta uhi.
english: When the ten heard it, they were indignant with the two brothers.

paite: Jesu'n amaute asam a, "Zentelte vaihawmte atung uah thu anei mahmah ua, amiliante un atung uah thu anei mahmah lai uh chih leng na thei uh.
english: But Jesus summoned them, and said, “You know that the rulers of the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.

paite: Himahleh nou lak ah zaw huchi ahi kei ding; kuapeuh na lak ua milian hih ut na nasem un a-om zaw ding hi.
english: It shall not be so among you; but whoever desires to become great among you shall be your servant.

paite: Kuapeuh na lak ua masapen hih ut na nasem un a-om lai ding ahi.
english: Whoever desires to be first among you shall be your bondservant,

paite: Mihing Tapa nasepsak a om ding in ahong pai kei a, nasem ding leh mi tampi tatna dia ahinna pe ding a hong pai ahi zaw hi," achi hi.
english: even as the Son of Man came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”

paite: Jeriko a kipan apawt lai un mipi tampitak in amah azui uhi.
heading: Jesu'n Mittaw Nih Ahihdam / (Mar 10.46-52; Luk 18.35-43)
english: As they went out from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.

paite: Ngai dih, mittaw nih lam gei a tute'n Jesu ahong pai chih azak un, "Toupa, Nang David Tapa, ka tung uah zahngai in," chi in akikou uhi.
english: Behold, two blind men sitting by the road, when they heard that Jesus was passing by, cried out, “Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!”

paite: Mipite'n dai ding in atai ua, himahleh amau, "Toupa, Nang David Tapa, ka tung uah zahngai in,” chi in akinak kou semsem uhi.
english: The multitude rebuked them, telling them that they should be quiet, but they cried out even more, “Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!”

paite: Jesu adingh a, amau asam a, "Na tung uah bang ka hih na ut ua?" achi hi.
english: Jesus stood still and called them, and asked, “What do you want me to do for you?”

paite: Amaute'n akiang ah, "Mitvak ka ut uh," achi uhi.
english: They told him, “Lord, that our eyes may be opened.”

paite: Jesu'n amau ahehpih mahmah a, amit uh akhoihsak a; huchi in amu thei pah ngal ua, amah azuita uhi.
english: Jesus, being moved with compassion, touched their eyes; and immediately their eyes received their sight, and they followed him.
